synthesis:draft.headline: Pre-dispatch is run half-hourly and the published pre-dispatch schedule is extended to cover the whole next trading day when next-day bid prices close.

document_statements.quote: Currently AEMO runs pre-dispatch every half hour, on the half hour
changes to dispatch bid and market ancillary service bid band prices for the next trading day close at 1230 hours EST
at that time AEMO publishes pre-dispatch for all 30-minute periods up to the end of the next trading day
